title: Island Lake Marine & Sports - Denver

services.name: Boat Rentals
services.desc: At Island Lake Marine, we want to bring water sports to as many people as possible and it’s no secret that owning your own boat can be very demanding. Now you can get out and surf/ski/wakeboard without the hassle and cost of owning your own boat or organizing your own Private Charter. It’s simple, join a single session tow for a flat rate or check out our Hang 10 packs to save money. Trying to get out on the water all season long? Go big and get the Unlimited Season Tow Pass for the ultimate value, nobody else in Colorado offers anything close. Tow Sessions are scheduled 2 hour time slots where individuals can sign up to get out on the water and shred behind a brand new top-of-the-line

services.name: Private Charter
services.desc: Whether you're hosting a work event, bachelor/bachelorette party, entertaining clients or just want to surf/sunbath Our charters operate on a Centurion or Supreme Wake Boat with the best wave on the market. The boats are decked out with a high quality audio syststem, comfortable seating, large bimini to provide plenty of shade and everything you'll need to drop the rope and wake surf with ease. Rather take the kids out and go tubing? No problem. Got an air chair or a knee board, bring whatever gear you'd like and well tow you! Our captains are CPR/first aid certified and are seasoned wake surfers/slalom skiers/wake boarders who can provide coaching. The boat can hold up to 13 guests

services.name: Surf Camp
services.desc: The term “Grommet” comes from the Australian surf community to describe young surfers moving up through the ranks. Island Lake Marine's Grommets (Kids) Surf Camp is Colorado's sickest camp around. Whether your little Grom is brand new or a seasoned rider trying to dial in tricks, we’ve got you covered! Camps are limited to 7 surfers, ages 6 - 14, and are run by our CPR/First Aid certified Captains/Instructors on a Centurion or Supreme Wake Boat with the leading wave on the market. In this 3 day camp your kids will not only learn the ropes of wake surfing but also crucial water and boating skills to maintain our number one goal - safety. No experience is required.
